ssdwear.stripe_unit_desc: Sets the default size, in bytes, of a chunk of an object stripe for erasure-coded pools. Every object of size S will be stored as N stripes, with each data chunk receiving stripe_unit bytes. Each stripe of N * stripe_unit bytes will be encoded/decoded individually. A value of 0 causes the code to select either a 4KB or 16KB stripe_unit depending on whether allow_ec_optimizations is enabled. If enabled, stripe_unit is set to 16KB, otherwise it is set to 4KB. This option can be overridden by the stripe_unit setting in an erasure code profile.
